messages:
ana: Heads-up: onboarding LyraX-8B int4. Long summarization jobs (>2k tokens) go into a short-loop around token ~2130.

sam: Can you paste the exact run command + seed?

ana: `python run_gen.py --model lyrax-8b --quant int4 --max-tokens 2500 --seed 42 --task summarization`. Repro is consistent on int4, clean on fp16.

carla: Any conversion warnings?

ana: Conversion log: WARN rotary_scale changed 1.0->0.9 for some head groups; kvcache head offset +1 reported.

dmitri: Smells like headmap/proj-order mismatch or rotary angle wrapping after conversion. Try a runtime head-swap test: `--head-order swap:3,7`.

ana: Swap reduced loops but hurt ROUGE a bit. Also ran token-diff: 23 tokenizer splits differ (ZWJ / composed vs decomposed accents).

ops-bot: queued eval #5587 comparing fp16, int4 raw, int4+swap, int4+tokfix. ETA ~12m.

ana: Short-term mitigation: implemented runtime fallback `--quant-fallback-threshold 1500` to int8 for long inputs. Opened PRs: convert mapping fix + tokenizer NFKC normalizer.

ops-bot: eval 5587 done: ROUGE-L fp16=42.0; int4(raw)=38.5; int4+swap=40.1; int4+tokfix=41.6; int4+fallback=41.7.

carla: Fallback wins quality-wise. Latency/cost hit?

ana: p50 +8ms, p99 +120ms for 2k-token requests; cost +~18% for those requests.

dmitri: Plan: merge tokenizer normalizer + convert fix, enable fallback feature-flag in staging, 72h smoke, promote to canary if stable. Add sliding-window perplexity to onboarding to catch future drift.

sam: Add regression test `tests/onboard/lyrax_longctx_repro.txt` and CI headmap roundtrip check.

ana: Done. Will monitor and ping eng-sre if errors spike. repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @repro_lyrax_longctx.json`.
